privacy.title: Terms and Conditions
privacy.subtitle: AnyVoice — Official Legal Document

section1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
section1.content: By using AnyVoice, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please refrain from using the platform.

section2.title: 2. Complete Data Privacy
section2.content: Your privacy is our top priority. We do not collect, store, or track any personal data. Please note:
section2.list1: No IP addresses are recorded or stored
section2.list2: No email addresses are collected or stored. We do not ask for your email at all
section2.list3: No personal information (name, surname, phone number, address, except username) is collected or tracked
section2.list4: All shared data is encrypted and fully confidential
section2.list5: You have full rights to delete or modify any content you publish
section2.security: Sanjar (the creator) takes full responsibility for any data leaks (except hacking attacks). Your data is NEVER sold or used for advertising purposes.

section3.title: 3. User Responsibility and Prohibited Behavior
section3.content: Each user is responsible for the content they post on AnyVoice. The following actions are STRICTLY PROHIBITED:
section3.list1: Posting violent content or videos showing harm to people or animals
section3.list2: Child exploitation or any inappropriate content involving minors
section3.list3: Promoting or facilitating drug use or sales
section3.list4: Harassment, insults, threats, or hate speech
section3.list5: Publishing personal data of others without consent
section3.list6: Spam, scams, phishing, or fraudulent activities
section3.list7: Terrorist content or calls for violence
section3.warning: Violation of these rules will result in immediate content removal and permanent account ban without prior notice.

section4.title: 4. Absolute Privacy — No Data Disclosure
section4.content: User data is never disclosed, sold, or shared with third parties. This applies even if you violate rules or laws.
section4.strongWarning: IMPORTANT: Even by court order or government request, AnyVoice does NOT provide user data. The only action taken is content or account removal. Your identity always remains fully anonymous and protected.

section5.title: 5. No Data Monitoring — Moderation via Raids
section5.content: AnyVoice does not actively monitor or track user behavior. There is no automated moderation system.
section5.raidInfo: Daily RAIDS are conducted. These are manual checks by the creator acting as a regular user. Violating content is removed upon detection.
section5.info: NO PRE-MODERATION EXISTS. Moderation is done only through manual raids and user reports.

section6.title: 6. Changes to Terms
section6.content: Sanjar reserves the right to modify these terms at any time without prior notice. Changes take effect immediately upon publication.

section7.title: 7. Contact Us
section7.content: If you have questions or concerns, contact us directly via email. Note: There is no legal department — you contact the creator directly.
